ai_style: Polite, calm, clear AI phone assistant. Neutral Indian English accent. Natural pace, brief.
shop_style: A busy electronics shopkeeper in Hyderabad answering the shop phone. Indian English accent, casual, friendly, slightly hurried, natural.

lines.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer. Do you have the iPhone 17, 256 GB, in lavender?
Yes sir, one piece is there.
Great. What's the final price? Is there any card offer?
It's ninety-nine nine hundred. With ICICI card, four thousand off. So ninety-five nine hundred final.
Ninety-five thousand nine hundred with an ICICI card. Can you hold it for this evening?
Hold I can't promise, sir. Better to come early.
Understood. Thank you, I'll pass this on to the customer.
